title: Download selected scoped loading-list evidence page as Chinese PDF
description: Users download selected field order and current evidence page as Chinese PDF from the existing designer. Dedicated PDF endpoint reuses current request/pure validation/fresh authorization/source and rebuilds the capped page without posted rows/preview cache. Narrow DynamicContainerStatsPdfExporter uses existing PDFsharp and local SimHei font resolution through direct controller call, no package/config/DI/font writes. Chinese headers, signed numeric recorded cartons/kg/m3 and counts retain separate units; utilization/type remain explicit unknown with reasons, no zero/68m3 fallback or whole-container/shipping claim. Mandatory normalized dates/filters/current page coverage/grouping/scoped counts/source cap/units/unknown capacity-type-shipping context is always printed. Wide finite columns split into column pages with bucket/date/coverage identity; tall pages repeat headers and avoid clipped/overlapping text, no unselected detail columns, all-match or mixed-unit totals. Font unavailable or render failure explicitly rejects file rather than empty/missing-glyph success. Page PDF download keeps field/filter/page state and displays failures. Verify bytes/text/page structure where supported and deterministic layout/render inputs, not screenshots or real browser acceptance. Development only. Reuse existing container-stats menu, current-user SalespersonDataScopeService customer scope, approved nondeleted ContainerLoadingLists and OperationLogMiddleware HTTP audit. Each endpoint revalidates current input and rechecks identity/menu/fresh scope; revoked permission, invalid input and source overflow return no data/file. Date span <=366 inclusive days, whole end day via next-day exclusive boundary with overflow rejection, stable source probe Take(501) and fail closed above 500 authorized matching list headers. Recorded cartons/kg/m3 are scoped list-header evidence, not verified stock-out, actual shipping, revenue or physical container totals. Partial customer scope must never reveal excluded customers/records or infer whole-container utilization, type, capacity or shipping state. No client identity/scope/rows/aggregates as authority, arbitrary/model-generated SQL, business writes, new domain entities or persistence schema, migrations, schema/view/stored-procedure changes, production SQL or real database execution, credentials/secrets/.env/config changes, irreversible operations, production deployment or real browser acceptance. Preserve unrelated modules and uncommitted work. Run focused in-memory service/API/export/UI source-contract tests plus configured safe Release build/test; unavailable external database/browser acceptance is environment-blocked, never fabricated passed.
acceptance_criteria: PDF endpoint validates current request and fresh identity/menu/customer scope and rebuilds the same capped selected page, failing closed on revocation, overflow and rendering failure.
Chinese PDF preserves selected field order, signed separate-unit numbers and unknown capacity/type with mandatory evidence context, repeated headers and explicit font/layout failure handling.
Existing PDF download preserves current state and displays errors; PDF/controller/UI tests cover scopes, caps, missing numbers, negative/zero values and unknowns, and safe build/test passes.
